target.title: feat(ios): read-only offline cache for chat sessions and transcripts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where opening the chat tab showed a blank transcript until the gateway responded, and showed nothing at all when the gateway was unreachable. All chat state was in memory only, so cold opens and offline periods left users staring at an empty screen even for conversations they had just been reading.

Part of #100194

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a small, disposable, read-only offline cache of recent chat sessions and transcripts, scoped per paired gateway identity. Cold opens paint the last known transcript immediately and the live gateway history then replaces it wholesale through the existing reconciliation path; the gateway remains the single source of truth whenever connected. The store is versioned SQLite with drop-and-rebuild on any mismatch — no migrations, no dual source of truth, no new dependencies. Text rows only; attachment payloads are never persisted, and the database uses complete-until-first-unlock file protection. The seam lives in the shared chat package behind a protocol (`OpenClawChatTranscriptCache`), so the macOS app can adopt it later; its call sites are untouched.

## User Impact

The chat tab now renders the last known conversation instantly on launch instead of a blank screen, and the session list plus recent transcripts stay browsable while disconnected. Sending stays disabled until the connection is healthy, exactly as before. Transcripts are cached per paired gateway and can never appear under a different gateway.

## Evidence

- `cd apps/shared/OpenClawKit && swift test --filter "ChatTranscriptCacheStoreTests|ChatViewModelTranscriptCacheTests"` — 15/15 pass: store round-trip, bounds (50 sessions / 50 transcripts / 200 messages), eviction order, gateway-identity scoping, schema/corruption drop-and-rebuild, attachment stripping; view-model tests prove cache-first paint then wholesale live replace, offline browsing after a failed history request, write-through of live history, and that live responses (including empty ones) always win over slow cache reads.
- `pnpm ios:build` (xcodebuild, iPhone 17 simulator, including SwiftFormat/SwiftLint phases) — BUILD SUCCEEDED.
- Existing `ChatViewModelTests` suite (105 tests) passes; no behavior change when no cache is injected (the parameter defaults to nil).
- Codex autoreview: 3 rounds; two accepted findings fixed with regression tests (stale cached sessions vs. live empty list; view-model recreation on paired-gateway switch so cache scopes can never cross), final round clean ("patch is correct", 0.82).

Known gaps: no on-device airplane-mode pass (view-model-level proof via scripted transport); cache rows for a forgotten gateway linger until evicted — hooking gateway "forget" to a purge is a follow-up. Note: `TalkConfigContractTests.selectionFixtures` and parallel-load `ChatViewModelTests` flakes reproduce on clean `origin/main` (verified with this diff stashed) — pre-existing, tracked separately.
